conditional_record_analysis.aggregation: Equal weight to matched fitted-model pairs and utility-test periods. Per-row sources above identify scores and labels; shared-record AUC influences are averaged before computing variance.
conditional_record_analysis.uncertainty_scope: Pointwise paired normal 95% interval using tie-aware AUC structural components, conditional on fitted models, fixed training data, one frozen RR realization and utility split. Within-period class-stratified IID-record approximation; not seed, corpus or source-population uncertainty. No equivalence inference from significance or overlap of raw-referenced intervals.

scope: Equal nominal max_features removes this specific parameter difference. Scikit-learn may inspect more features until finding a valid split; neither exactly three examined features per node nor equal total compute is claimed. Protected field availability and total feature count still differ; this is not a fully causal privacy-utility decomposition, hyperparameter optimization, or evidence that an epsilon cost is operationally necessary. The post-result amendment and all earlier outcomes are retained.
registration: Outcome-informed amendment after the original and 108-fit seed results disclosed the sqrt candidate-count confound. Frozen before any outcomes of these 24 new fits. Not an external preregistration or a tuning search.
randomness: Reuse the same three completed training seeds and fixed RR training/scoring realization. A seed pairing is not identical RNG consumption across different feature spaces. No new RR draws, raw fits or RR fits.

uncertainty.seeds: For each family/period and family/overall aggregation, reduce to three replicate-level paired gains first. Report n=3, sample SD, min/max, and Student-t pointwise95% interval with df2. These intervals assume approximately normal independent replicate effects, are unstable with only3 seeds, and condition on fixed RR, corpus, rosters and utility panel. Families, periods, test records and seeds are not pooled as independent replications. No multiple-testing adjustment; no equivalence margin or declaration.
uncertainty.records: Separately report paired conditional record-sampling intervals averaged over fixed fitted models, preserving shared utility-record correlations. Do not combine with training-seed intervals or interpret either as RR-draw or population uncertainty.
